mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte depletion (particularly potassium and magnesium), which may impair ezetimibe metabolism and increase risk of myopathy; ezetimibe also has potential for muscle toxicity that could be potentiated by amphotericin B-induced electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and CK levels closely; consider temporary discontinuation of ezetimibe during amphotericin B therapy if renal function declines significantly, and ensure aggressive electrolyte replacement.
